newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: ALPINE SKIING-WIBERG UNDERLINES WORLD CUP SUPREMACY.
newsitem.headline: ALPINE SKIING-WIBERG UNDERLINES WORLD CUP SUPREMACY.

text.p: Sweden's Pernilla Wiberg increased her lead in the World Cup overall standings when she won a women's slalom on Saturday.
Wiberg, fastest on the first run, was not put off by the deteriorating conditions on the Radvanje piste and clocked the best aggregate time of one minute 44.55 seconds.
Urska Hrovat delighted home crowds in Slovenia's second largest city, with second place in 1:45.32.
Italy's Lara Magoni improved from seventh to third with 1:46.46 -- her best World Cup performance.
